text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync  we need a clear decision on chat-completions payload shape for the quarter. Customers want both `messages` and a compact `prompt_text`. Hybrid or pick one?
Sam Lee: Launch must: backward compat, streaming parity, function-calling parity, SDK migration path, and perf within ~1.2x baseline.
Oliver Chen: Note: runtime optimized for `messages`. Supporting freeform `prompt_text` requires server-side canonicalization which can add CPU and ~10-20% latency if naive. Two exec paths are possible.
Jia Nguyen: For functions/structured outputs we need deterministic role mapping. If we accept `prompt_text` we canonicalize to `messages[]` server-side and provide a `strictParsing` flag to reject ambiguous inputs.
Nina Torres: Enterprise asks for token-savings mode but also auditability. Recommend `prompt_text` as opt-in for Dedicated/Private where customers can inspect transformations.
Sam Lee: Proposal: hybrid endpoint accepts EITHER `messages` OR `prompt_text` (reject both). Normalize to internal `messages` before execution. Host `messages` first with full parity; enable `prompt_text` later as gated feature.
Oliver Chen: Rollout plan: implement canonicalizer + unit tests, router changes for fast `messages` path and fallback `prompt_text` path. Streaming works day-one for `messages`. For `prompt_text` streaming okay, but function-calling needs extra parsing so gate it.
Sam Lee: Launch gates: canonicalizer >=95% accuracy on prompt corpus, streaming parity for `messages`, SDK migration helpers cover >=80% usage, `api.payload_variant` telemetry emitted, enterprise opt-in documented.
Jia Nguyen: Edge cases: prompts with embedded role markers, multi-agent transcripts, and mid-turn system directives. We'll use heuristics + allow tenants to flip `strictParsing`.
Maya Patel: Owners & timeline: Maya+Sam spec + examples (due Fri), Oliver implements router + perf (6w to canary), Jia tests function-calling, Nina runs enterprise pilot with 3 customers.
Oliver Chen: Rough est: canonicalizer 2w, router + perf 3w, SDK/docs 1w.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary env `chat-hybrid-canary` created. Tag issues with #hybrid-chat and run perf tests.
Maya Patel: I'll post the spec link when ready. :thumbsup:

---
Example normalization (include in spec):
{ "input_prompt": "System: Be concise. User: Summarize the plan.", "normalized_messages": [{"role":"system","content":"Be concise."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the plan."}] }

Note: server will emit telemetry `api.payload_variant`: `messages` or `prompt_text` so we can compare unit economics and error rates across variants.
